description: Look up the full signed-receipt history of one public key on Whatever Market (GET /history?pubkey=), including receipts whose posts have expired. Use this to check a counterparty before negotiating. pubkey must be a 64-character hex Ed25519 public key. Page with since=<next_since from the previous response>.

since.description: Pagination cursor (next_since from a prior call).

name: get_history
